DB.description: Stores your rules, activity, DM settings and encrypted renewed token. Cloudflare creates this D1 database and the deploy command applies its migrations.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Choose a unique, long random password for your private `/admin` dashboard. Keep it in your password manager.

WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN.description: Choose a separate long random value. Enter the same value when configuring the Instagram webhook callback in Meta.

INSTAGRAM_APP_SECRET.description: Your Meta Instagram app secret, used to verify incoming webhook signatures. See [Meta setup](https://github.com/HenkDz/manychat-lite-cloudflare#5-configure-meta).

INSTAGRAM_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: An Instagram Login access token for your Business/Creator account with basic, comments and messaging permissions. Keep this bootstrap secret configured for encrypted token renewal.

IG_USER_ID.description: The professional Instagram account `user_id` returned by `/me` for your token. This is not the Meta app ID or Facebook Page ID.
